proves.claim: gate --withdraw shards --stale-before lists with --dry-run and ends nothing, then ends the offered shards of the stale gate and leaves the claimed one.

cli.journeys-gate-withdraw-stale.dry-run.why: Without it, the coordinator's command could end shards on a dry run, miss the stale gate's offered shards, or end a claimed shard.

proves.claim: The item gets one note naming the gate job, the shards ended, the missing commit and the next step.

cli.journeys-gate-withdraw-stale.item-fa.why: Without it, a builder whose gate shards were ended would not know why or that a main merge and resubmit is next.

proves.claim: A builder seat is refused, and --stale-before or --withdraw shards alone refuse USAGE; nothing ends.

cli.journeys-gate-withdraw-stale.refusal.why: Without it, any seat could end every stale gate's shards, or a half-typed command could act.
